proposal.reason: The single Python aggregate timed out (two sequential ORCA jobs exceeded the 1200 s script limit; -120 job was cut). Pivot to direct per-angle orca.run provenance. This step materializes the five missing admitted ORCA inputs (matching the previously admitted B3LYP/def2-TZVP/RKS/Opt/%geom D 0 1 2 3 ... C format) and, since its admitted input artifact and the prepared geometry already exist, launches the -120 constrained optimization directly. No Python retries or future-artifact references are used; remaining orca.run Steps for the new inputs can be bound by their receipts next.
